tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Run b/cited's Site Readiness scan on one public URL: a rule-based audit (not model-judged) of 30+ observable signals across nine categories — indexing, metadata, social cards, structured data, AEO (llms.txt, ai.txt, AI-crawler stance in robots.txt, FAQPage/HowTo/Author schema), international, mobile

tools.name: list_leaderboard_categories
tools.description: List the 12 industry categories of b/cited's public AEO readiness leaderboard (slug, name, description). Use a slug with get_leaderboard.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Return one category of b/cited's public AEO readiness leaderboard: every curated domain ranked by overall readiness score (0–100) with its letter grade and AEO score, as scanned weekly by the same rule-based scanner as scan_site. Unscanned domains sort last with null scores. Use list_leaderboard_cat

tools.name: get_domain_readiness
tools.description: Look up one domain on b/cited's public AEO readiness leaderboard: its rank, grade, overall and AEO scores in every category it appears in, the AEO-category checks from its most recent weekly scan, and its score history (newest first). Only the 180 curated leaderboard domains are here; for any other

tools.name: get_prompt_citations
tools.description: For one leaderboard category, which sites OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity cited when asked b/cited's fixed set of buyer prompts, for one ISO week (default: the latest recorded). Per prompt and engine: the ordered cited hosts and whether each is on the board; per board domain: cited on N of M prompt

tools.name: lookup_glossary
tools.description: Define a term the way b/cited's glossary defines it — AEO, citation, brand rank, visibility score, authority score, topical cluster, coverage diff, llms.txt, ai.txt, and 30 more.
